readiness: Local NEAR testnet v1.0 within the approved scope; not a mainnet launch or independent security audit

rustContract.scope: Native NEAR SDK unit tests, not a full sandbox suite

fullRuns.evidence: Recorded command output and qa/v1-round-1 artifacts; no standalone JSON retained

browser.boundary: Browser data, signature and transaction boundaries use fixtures in selected journeys. The pinned Meteor executor and opening the official web wallet are also tested. Human account selection/signing is not claimed.

testnet.boundary: Selected real testnet transactions and contract callbacks are covered. Every possible live RPC outage, callback loss or power-cut timing has not been injected.

localModel.boundary: Provider enable/disable and typed proposals tested separately; this historical model smoke is not a new independent audit.

dependencyAudit.residualRisk: Eight low-severity findings remain in the transitive NEAR SDK elliptic/secp256k1 chain. This release uses ed25519 for login verification and the executor. No forced downgrade or unreviewed major dependency replacement was applied.

limitations: Intents conversions, DCA fills, stocks/ETFs, Earn, flexible payday and loans are explicitly simulated as approved. They do not move mainnet funds or promise market yield.
Actual salary settlement and savings use native testNEAR on NEAR testnet; no fabricated testNEAR/demoUSD exchange rate exists.

The current contract has finite storage limits: 30 companies, 50 employees per company, 20 obligations per authorization batch, 2000 obligations/withdrawals, 10 goals per account and 12000 events. Growth needs a reviewed migration.
Legacy chain accounting begins with a labelled opening snapshot; unavailable historic detail is not fabricated.
One future salary amendment is supported until it becomes effective. Partially signed decisions must be resolved before overlapping changes.
The local device, API, worker and internet must remain available for scheduled execution. A local v1 release is not public hosting.
Manual human Meteor selection/signing, long-duration load testing, all live network failure modes, mainnet readiness and independent security audit are not claimed.
The operational ledger is not a country-specific statutory accounting or tax product.
